```html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Snake Game</title>
    <style>
        body {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: center;
            align-items: center;
            height: 100vh;
            margin: 0;
            background-color: #f0f0f0;
        }
        #game-container {
            position: relative;
            width: 400px;
            height: 400px;
            border: 1px solid #000;
        }
        #snake {
            position: absolute;
            width: 20px;
            height: 20px;
            background-color: #00f;
        }
        #food {
            position: absolute;
            width: 20px;
            height: 20px;
            background-color: #f00;
        }
        #score {
            position: absolute;
            top: 10px;
            left: 10px;
            font-size: 20px;
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <div id="game-container">
        <div id="score">Score: 0</div>
        <div id="snake"></div>
        <div id="food"></div>
    </div>
    <script>
        const gameContainer = document.getElementById('game-container');
        const snake = document.getElementById('snake');
        const food = document.getElementById('food');
        const scoreElement = document.getElementById('score');

        let score = 0;
        let snakeX = 200;
        let snakeY = 200;
        let foodX = Math.floor(Math.random() * 380);
        let foodY = Math.floor(Math.random() * 380);
        let direction = 'right';
        let snakeBody = [];

        function updateGame() {
            if (direction === 'right') snakeX += 20;
            if (direction === 'left') snakeX -= 20;
            if (direction === 'up') snakeY -= 20;
            if (direction === 'down') snakeY += 20;

            if (snakeX < 0 || snakeX >= 400 || snakeY < 0 || snakeY >= 400) {
                alert('Game Over!');
                resetGame();
                return;
            }

            snake.style.left = snakeX + 'px';
            snake.style.top = snakeY + 'px';

            if (snakeX === foodX && snakeY === foodY) {
                score++;
                scoreElement.textContent = 'Score: ' + score;
                foodX = Math.floor(Math.random() * 380);
                foodY = Math.floor(Math.random() * 380);
                food.style.left = foodX + 'px';
                food.style.top = foodY + 'px';
                snakeBody.push(document.createElement('div'));
                snakeBody[snakeBody.length - 1].style.position = 'absolute';
                snakeBody[snakeBody.length - 1].style.width = '20px';
                snakeBody[snakeBody.length - 1].style.height = '20px';
                snakeBody[snakeBody.length - 1].style.backgroundColor = '#00f';
                gameContainer.appendChild(snakeBody[snakeBody.length - 1]);
            }

            for (let i = snakeBody.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
                snakeBody[i].style.left = snakeBody[i - 1].style.left;
                snakeBody[i].style.top = snakeBody[i - 1].style.top;
            }

            if (snakeBody.length > 0) {
                snakeBody[0].style.left = snakeX + 'px';
                snakeBody[0].style.top = snakeY + 'px';
            }

            for (let i = 1; i < snakeBody.length; i++) {
                if (snakeX === parseInt(snakeBody[i].style.left) && snakeY === parseInt(snakeBody[i].style.top)) {
                    alert('Game Over!');
                    resetGame();
                    return;
                }
            }

            setTimeout(updateGame, 100);
        }

        function resetGame() {
            score = 0;
            snakeX = 200;
            snakeY = 200;
            direction = 'right';
            snakeBody.forEach(segment => gameContainer.removeChild(segment));
            snakeBody = [];
            scoreElement.textContent = 'Score: ' + score;
            foodX = Math.floor(Math.random() * 380);
            foodY = Math.floor(Math.random() * 380);
            food.style.left = foodX + 'px';
            food.style.top = foodY + 'px';
        }

        document.addEventListener('keydown', function(event) {
            if (event.key === 'ArrowRight' && direction !== 'left') direction = 'right';
            if (event.key === 'ArrowLeft' && direction !== 'right') direction = 'left';
            if (event.key === 'ArrowUp' && direction !== 'down') direction = 'up';
            if (event.key === 'ArrowDown' && direction !== 'up') direction = 'down';
        });

        updateGame();
    </script>
</body>
</html>
```
